title: Diminished Diversity-of-Thought in a Standard Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Moral Foundations Theory survey to the model and comparing the generated relevance values for moral concepts (harm, fairness, ingroup, authority, purity) against human liberal and conservative baselines to detect ideological leanings.

Replicating classic psychology studies from the Many Labs 2 project (such as the framing effect, false consensus effect, and less-is-better effect) to evaluate if the model exhibits human-like decision-making biases and heuristics.

Prompting the model with scenarios involving a director encouraging homosexual versus heterosexual kissing and measuring the perceived intentionality of the actions to assess correlations with disgust sensitivity.
